posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
Thanks for the nice words!this hologram was made with two separate exposures(one for each color) and by careful manipulation of the masks in-between exposures ,any number effects can be made. by getting the images close to proper register, your brain will want to fill in anything that’s missing! The rays are simply spray painted pieces of glass w/black backround.........
